source_taxonomy: CORINE Land Cover (CLC) Level 3 labels in BigEarthNet/reBEN metadata

authoritative_source.title: BigEarthNet v2.0 dataset description
authoritative_source.location: Table 1: mapping from CLC Level-3 classes to the 19-class nomenclature

mapping.Land principally occupied by agriculture: Land principally occupied by agriculture, with significant areas of natural vegetation
mapping.Natural grassland: Natural grassland and sparsely vegetated areas
mapping.Sparsely vegetated areas: Natural grassland and sparsely vegetated areas

explicitly_unmapped: Road and rail networks and associated land
rationale: Entries are a direct transcription of the authoritative Table 1. Target strings are matched exactly to the runtime NEW_LABELS order; no source label is inferred from wording alone. The source table marks explicitly_unmapped classes as Unlabeled, so they never become negative target labels.
